spec.outcome: Keep every executable AKS E2E spec verified through the Azure DevOps staging pipeline, with each non-pass represented by bounded repair, rerun, or an exact external wait.
acceptance: Every executable spec is passing or has a reviewed terminal escalation explaining why bounded repository-local work cannot make it pass.
Every fail or error has an exact classification and either a repair-and-rerun successor or an escalation with a precise resume Condition.
The workflow keeps at most five useful non-conflicting verifier leaves moving while pending or retryable specs remain.

spec.outcome: Keep feature-owned compact plans complete for their feature spec sets and verified by passing live Azure DevOps staging runs.
acceptance: A compact item is done only when its feature plan covers the feature-owned specs and its live staging run passed.
Every non-pass feature has a bounded repair-and-rerun path or an exact escalation after repository-local fixes are exhausted.
The workflow keeps at most three useful non-conflicting compact leaves moving while pending or retryable features remain.

spec.outcome: Keep the strict scenario-test inventory clean by normalizing each active spec into one direct feature-owned test with exact live verification and serialized publication.
acceptance: A clean origin/dev passes bun scripts/check-scenario-tests.ts --strict with no referenced or repository plain scenario carriers.
Each normalized spec has one source-grounded direct test, truthful mutation and cleanup behavior, an exact live pass for its tested commit, and publication evidence.
Each current missing adapter has concrete moving work, an exact Condition or escalation, or a reviewed terminal disposition.
The owner keeps three to five useful non-conflicting one-spec leaves moving while the strict inventory remains red.
